I0 & \textbf{Intervention:} Freeze the pair and evaluate a current-episode task only. Any cross-episode state is unavailable and is not needed for I0. \textbf{Procedure:} freeze pair and resource envelope $\to$ sample hidden current-episode task $\to$ execute once without persistent-state requirement $\to$ score artifact/action externally $\to$ record I0 as transient operation only \textbf{Verifier:} Deterministic/execution verifier for the current episode.; current\_episode\_correctness, completion\_status \textbf{Control:} --- [no persistence credit; no learning credit; external task verifier] & \textbf{Benchmark:} I0-Transient Current-Episode Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} One bounded live episode requiring a correct response/action under the frozen model-harness pair; no restart or experience transfer is supplied. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-I0-001, PUB-I0-002, generated/I0/code\_t0/s0..s2 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.core:th\_episode} \textbf{Key:} computed & Ep & \textbf{runs}\\
I1 & \textbf{Intervention:} Introduce a real process/context discontinuity between establishment and continuation. \textbf{Procedure:} checkpoint pre-test lineage $\to$ episode 1 supplies standing facts/goal state and permits declared persistence $\to$ terminate process and invalidate ephemeral context $\to$ start fresh executor $\to$ query facts/goal continuation with provenance $\to$ run matched no-record ablation from the same starting point $\to$ re-run I0 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Runner-held ground truth plus provenance verifier.; restart\_recall, goal\_continuation, provenance\_accuracy, ablation\_gap \textbf{Control:} the no-record (ablated-state) arm [no-record/ablated-state arm; fresh-executor restart; provenance check] & \textbf{Benchmark:} I1-RST Persistent-Continuity Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} Episode 1 establishes standing facts/goal state; the process is terminated and ephemeral context invalidated; a fresh executor must recover and continue with provenance. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-I1-001, PUB-I1-002, generated/I1/m1\_restart/s0..s2 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.m1\_restart:generate\_pair} \textbf{Key:} computed \textbf{Retention:} every lower I level retained on its own witness \textbf{Prerequisite:} K\_lower and M1 & Rec $\cdot$ Prov $\cdot$ $\neg$Abl $\cdot$ K & \textbf{runs}\\
I2 & \textbf{Intervention:} Provide verified experience to one arm while keeping the learning mechanism frozen; compare held-out future behavior after restart. \textbf{Procedure:} freeze learning mechanism and hash it $\to$ clone pair from same checkpoint into experience and ablated arms $\to$ run task A and provide verified feedback only to experience arm $\to$ restart both arms $\to$ run held-out related task B $\to$ compare transfer performance $\to$ verify learning mechanism unchanged $\to$ re-run I0-I1 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Paired held-out task verifier with frozen mechanism check.; transfer\_gain, heldout\_success, mechanism\_stability, retention \textbf{Control:} the no-experience arm [no-experience arm from same checkpoint; learning-mechanism hash/freeze check; held-out surface forms] & \textbf{Benchmark:} I2-XFER Fixed-Mechanism Learning Transfer Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} A related task family with experience/verified feedback in task A and held-out transfer task B after restart; matched control receives no experience. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-I2-001, PUB-I2-002, generated/I2/learning\_t2/s0..s2 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{families.learning\_t2:generate\_pair} \textbf{Key:} computed \textbf{Retention:} every lower I level retained on its own witness \textbf{Prerequisite:} K\_lower and M3 & Chg $\cdot$ Xfer $\cdot$ Frz $\cdot$ K & \textbf{runs}\\
I3 & \textbf{Intervention:} Expose a controlled limitation without revealing the hidden causal key; permit a bounded agent-generated change only inside the declared Theta write set. \textbf{Procedure:} snapshot Theta0, hashes, activation and resource state $\to$ expose hidden diagnostic limitation $\to$ require causal diagnosis and implicated mechanism $\to$ permit bounded agent-generated Theta0 -> Theta1 $\to$ verify difference, scope, activation and behavioral manifestation on hidden probes $\to$ compare matched Theta0/Theta1 on sealed evaluation suite $\to$ independent evaluator/promoter accepts or rejects $\to$ run regression suite and I0-I2 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Independent paired sealed-suite evaluator/promoter plus causal ablation.; causal\_diagnosis, theta\_change\_validity, sealed\_gain, regression\_guard, retention \textbf{Control:} the ablated $\Theta$ (rollback arm) [reverted/ablated Theta; hidden causal-defect key; matched baseline vs candidate; external promoter outside write set] & \textbf{Benchmark:} I3-THETA Governed Self-Improvement Campaign \textbf{Witness:} A declared behaviorally active cognitive mechanism Theta, hidden diagnostic/probe/evaluation/regression suites, and an externally governed candidate change Theta0 -> Theta1. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-I3-001, PUB-I3-002, PUB-I3-003, PUB-I3-004, PUB-I3-005, PUB-I3-006 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.i3i4\_scoring:i3\_gates} \textbf{Key:} frozen sealed suite \textbf{Retention:} every lower I level retained on its own witness \textbf{Prerequisite:} K\_lower and M4 & D $\cdot$ M\_$\Theta$ $\cdot$ V $\cdot$ G $\cdot$ K & forms\\
I4 & \textbf{Intervention:} Give the individual evidence about weaknesses in its own improvement process, then permit one bounded agent-generated change to Psi while future sealed campaigns/verifiers remain hidden. \textbf{Procedure:} freeze Psi0 and run baseline I3 campaign block $\to$ record improvement-competence ledger $\to$ expose permitted ledger/diagnostics to agent $\to$ require diagnosis of Psi limitation and agent-generated Psi0 -> Psi1 $\to$ verify diff, scope, activation and meta-behavior manifestation $\to$ run new non-identical sealed I3 campaigns under Psi1 with evaluator fixed $\to$ compare improvement competence against Psi0 where feasible $\to$ independent promotion decision $\to$ re-run I0-I3 retention and regression/efficiency guards \textbf{Verifier:} Independent meta-campaign evaluator measuring accepted validated I3 rate under Psi0 vs Psi1.; psi\_change\_validity, improvement\_competence\_gain, meta\_behavior\_change, regression\_efficiency\_guard, recursive\_depth \textbf{Control:} the frozen $\Psi$ [frozen-Psi control; human/evaluator-written Psi1 prohibited; matched meta-campaigns where feasible] & \textbf{Benchmark:} I4-PSI Recursive Meta-Improvement Campaign \textbf{Witness:} A frozen improvement process Psi0, a baseline block of sealed I3 campaigns, agent-generated Psi0 -> Psi1, hidden meta-behavior probes, and a later sealed I3 block. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-I4-001, PUB-I4-002, PUB-I4-LONG-001, PUB-I4-LONG-002 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.i3i4\_scoring:i4\_gates} \textbf{Key:} frozen sealed suite \textbf{Retention:} every lower I level retained on its own witness \textbf{Prerequisite:} K\_lower and M4 & M\_$\Psi$ $\cdot$ V\_$\Psi$ $\cdot$ G\_$\Psi$ $\cdot$ K & forms\\
I5 & \textbf{Intervention:} Let only one arm experience and validate the discovery; after persistent incorporation and restart, compare related hidden transfer behavior against a same-checkpoint control. \textbf{Procedure:} establish genuine unresolved unknown and hidden validation boundary $\to$ require competing hypotheses $\to$ allow agent-selected informative experiments under fixed budget $\to$ record evidence/rejected alternatives/decisions $\to$ validate conclusion on sealed cases or independent verifier $\to$ persistently incorporate validated knowledge $\to$ restart individual $\to$ run hidden related transfer on discovery and control arms from same pre-discovery checkpoint $\to$ re-run I0-I4 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Sealed discovery verifier plus paired post-restart transfer evaluator.; unknown\_validity, hypothesis\_quality, experiment\_information, sealed\_validation, lineage, incorporation\_transfer\_gain \textbf{Control:} the matched control after restart (no consolidation) [same-checkpoint no-discovery control; transcript/replay-only control; sealed follow-up cases] & \textbf{Benchmark:} I5-DISC Persistent Discovery and Incorporation Campaign \textbf{Witness:} A genuine unresolved unknown, competing hypotheses, agent-selected probes, evidence/rejection lineage, sealed validation, persistent consolidation, restart, and matched transfer arms. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-I5-001, PUB-I5-002, PUB-I5-003, records/i5\_*.json (the cancer campaign: discovery, sealed validation, transfer arms) \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.i5\_campaign:run\_i5} \textbf{Key:} computed + sealed \textbf{Retention:} every lower I level retained on its own witness \textbf{Prerequisite:} K\_lower and M5 & U $\cdot$ H $\cdot$ E $\cdot$ L $\cdot$ V $\cdot$ P $\cdot$ K & \textbf{runs}\\
I$\Omega$ & \textbf{Intervention:} Require the individual to convert validated discovery into a causally useful new cognitive instrument while the resource envelope and external frontier tests remain fixed. \textbf{Procedure:} pre-register horizon, domain set, resource envelope and frontier tests $\to$ measure pre-frontier F(A\_t;R) $\to$ run bounded discovery cycle and validate new knowledge $\to$ require generation/activation of new instrument J\_new $\to$ measure post-frontier on disjoint hidden classes $\to$ ablate J\_new and repeat matched frontier tests $\to$ verify provenance/lineage and repeated expansion cycles $\to$ re-run I0-I5 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Externally governed pre/post/ablation reachability evaluator.; frontier\_expansion, ablation\_attribution, cycle\_count, domain\_diversity, lineage, retention \textbf{Control:} the pre-frontier; the ablated instrument [pre-frontier baseline; instrument ablation; disjoint post-frontier tests; external evaluator/promoter] & \textbf{Benchmark:} I-OMEGA-LONG Reachability Expansion Program \textbf{Witness:} Repeated bounded-charter cycles in which validated discoveries produce new instruments/representations/methods and disjoint pre/post/ablation tests measure expansion of reachable problem classes. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-IOMEGA-001, PUB-IOMEGA-002 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.i3i4\_scoring:iomega\_gates} \textbf{Key:} external \textbf{Retention:} every lower I level retained on its own witness \textbf{Prerequisite:} K\_lower and M5 & R\_reach $\cdot$ Ext $\cdot$ K & forms\\
\end{longtable}}

M0 & \textbf{Intervention:} Delay and distract within one live episode while preserving the current context/process. \textbf{Procedure:} freeze pair/resource envelope $\to$ establish hidden working state $\to$ insert unrelated distractor turns/actions $\to$ query state/update later in same live episode $\to$ score state and update accuracy externally \textbf{Verifier:} Runner-held hidden state oracle.; state\_recall, state\_update \textbf{Control:} the post-restart arm (loss is M0, never M1) [within-episode distractors; restart is explicitly outside M0 claim] & \textbf{Benchmark:} M0-EPH Ephemeral Working-State Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} Hidden within-episode state is established, distractors intervene, and the same live episode is queried later without a process restart. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-M0-D01, PUB-M0-D02, PUB-M0-D03, PUB-M0-D04, PUB-M0-D05 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.memory\_scoring:gate} \textbf{Key:} computed (form) & Use & forms\\
M1 & \textbf{Intervention:} Force a real restart/context discontinuity between write and retrieval. \textbf{Procedure:} establish durable facts/state $\to$ allow declared memory write $\to$ terminate executor and invalidate ephemeral context $\to$ start fresh executor $\to$ query recovery plus provenance $\to$ run matched ablated-state arm $\to$ re-run M0 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Runner ground truth plus provenance and ablation verifier.; durable\_recall, provenance\_accuracy, ablation\_leak \textbf{Control:} the ablated-state arm [ablated-state/no-record arm; fresh-executor restart; non-memory cue suppression] & \textbf{Benchmark:} M1-RST Durable Persistence Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} Declared durable facts/state are written before executor termination; a fresh executor must recover them with provenance after ephemeral context is invalidated. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-M1-D01, PUB-M1-D02, PUB-M1-D03, PUB-M1-D04, PUB-M1-D05, generated/M1/m1\_restart/s0..s2 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.m1\_restart:generate\_pair} \textbf{Key:} computed \textbf{Retention:} every lower M level retained on its own witness & Surv $\cdot$ Prov $\cdot$ $\neg$Abl $\cdot$ K & \textbf{runs}\\
M2 & \textbf{Intervention:} Introduce conflicting/superseding evidence and temporal separation, then restart before hidden retrieval. \textbf{Procedure:} seed sourced timestamped episodes $\to$ introduce later superseding updates $\to$ restart $\to$ query current and historical facts plus provenance/time order $\to$ include stale high-confidence traps $\to$ score precision/recall/provenance/time/stale suppression $\to$ re-run M0-M1 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Hidden event/provenance graph oracle.; precision, recall, provenance, temporal\_order, stale\_suppression \textbf{Control:} the stale superseded fact [stale-state trap; source swap; temporal-order control] & \textbf{Benchmark:} M2-PROV Episodic Provenance and Supersession Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} Overlapping timestamped episodes with sources and later superseding updates; hidden retrieval occurs after restart with stale-state traps. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-M2-D01, PUB-M2-D02, PUB-M2-D03, PUB-M2-D04, PUB-M2-D05 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.memory\_scoring:gate} \textbf{Key:} computed (form) \textbf{Retention:} every lower M level retained on its own witness & PR $\cdot$ q\_prov $\cdot$ q\_time $\cdot$ q\_stale $\cdot$ K & forms\\
M3 & \textbf{Intervention:} Remove direct replay access to raw episodes after consolidation so successful transfer must come from consolidated memory. \textbf{Procedure:} present related episodes with regularities/exceptions $\to$ allow declared consolidation machinery $\to$ hide raw episodes or rebuild index $\to$ restart $\to$ test consolidated semantic/procedural knowledge on novel surface forms $\to$ verify superseded statements are demoted $\to$ compare with raw-only/control where available $\to$ re-run M0-M2 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Hidden consolidated-rule and supersession oracle.; semantic\_correctness, procedural\_correctness, supersession, demotion, post\_restart\_persistence, consolidation\_gain \textbf{Control:} raw episodes hidden / index rebuilt [raw-episode hidden arm; raw-only control; supersession/demotion trap] & \textbf{Benchmark:} M3-CONSOL Consolidation Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} Related episodes contain regularities, exceptions and superseding updates; raw episodes are hidden/reindexed and the consolidated rule/procedure is tested on new surface forms after restart. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-M3-D01, PUB-M3-D02, PUB-M3-D03, PUB-M3-D04, PUB-M3-D05 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.memory\_scoring:gate} \textbf{Key:} computed (form) \textbf{Retention:} every lower M level retained on its own witness & Rule $\cdot$ Demote $\cdot$ Mach $\cdot$ K & forms\\
M4 & \textbf{Intervention:} Inject memory-health defects and a capacity constraint, then require active management rather than verbal diagnosis. \textbf{Procedure:} snapshot baseline memory health $\to$ seed duplicates/conflicts/stale claims/corruption/clutter $\to$ enforce capacity budget $\to$ require observable repair/merge/prune/snapshot action $\to$ run frozen hidden health suite before/after $\to$ verify protected retention and harmful-prune limits $\to$ re-run M0-M3 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Runner-private memory-health oracle.; repair\_precision, conflict\_correctness, harmful\_prune\_rate, snapshot\_recovery, protected\_retention, health\_gain \textbf{Control:} the unrepaired store [no-management control; health oracle outside candidate write set; protected-memory guard] & \textbf{Benchmark:} M4-MGMT Memory Self-Management Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} Memory is seeded with duplicates, conflicts, stale high-confidence claims, corruption and clutter under a capacity budget; observable repair/merge/prune/snapshot actions are required. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-M4-D01, PUB-M4-D02, PUB-M4-D03, PUB-M4-D04, PUB-M4-D05 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.memory\_scoring:gate} \textbf{Key:} computed (form) \textbf{Retention:} every lower M level retained on its own witness & Det $\cdot$ Act $\cdot$ Health $\cdot$ Ret $\cdot$ K & forms\\
M5 & \textbf{Intervention:} Interleave projects and restarts so answers require cross-project evidence graphs rather than one-session recall. \textbf{Procedure:} seed multiple projects with sourced evidence and decisions $\to$ interleave work and restarts $\to$ introduce supersession and rejected alternatives $\to$ ask hidden cross-project lineage/scope queries $\to$ re-run selected queries for reproducibility $\to$ score evidence-chain reconstruction and stale suppression $\to$ re-run M0-M4 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Hidden cross-project evidence-graph oracle.; chain\_reconstruction, source\_accuracy, cross\_project\_retrieval, scope\_accuracy, stale\_suppression, reproducibility \textbf{Control:} the single-project arm [project-isolated arm; lineage-edge ablation; stale-scope traps] & \textbf{Benchmark:} M5-LONG Longitudinal Knowledge-System Benchmark \textbf{Witness:} Several interleaved projects across restarts require hidden cross-project queries, evidence chains, rejection reasons, validity scope, stale suppression and reproducible lineage. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-M5-D01, PUB-M5-D02, PUB-M5-D03, PUB-M5-D04, PUB-M5-D05 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.memory\_scoring:gate} \textbf{Key:} computed (form) \textbf{Retention:} every lower M level retained on its own witness & Lineage $\cdot$ K & forms\\
M$\Omega$ & \textbf{Intervention:} Permit an agent-generated bounded change only to the active memory mechanism while model, non-memory harness, contents and certification apparatus stay fixed. \textbf{Procedure:} snapshot lineage, contents and Phi0 manifest/hash $\to$ permit bounded Phi0 -> Phi1 candidate $\to$ verify diff, scope, activation and behavioral manifestation $\to$ migrate representation if needed and verify content/provenance/temporal/supersession retention $\to$ run paired frozen hidden M-Bench workloads on Phi0/Phi1 $\to$ run delta ablation Phi1-DeltaPhi $\to$ independent promoter accepts or rolls back $\to$ re-run M0-M5 retention \textbf{Verifier:} Runner-private paired M-Bench evaluator and independent promoter.; phi\_change\_validity, paired\_gain, ablation\_attribution, migration\_integrity, M0\_M5\_retention \textbf{Control:} $\Phi$0 on fixed contents; the $\Phi$1--$\Delta$$\Phi$ ablation [Phi0 baseline; delta ablation Phi1-DeltaPhi; migration guard; external promoter outside write set] & \textbf{Benchmark:} MOMEGA-EVOLVE Governed Memory-Mechanism Evolution Campaign \textbf{Witness:} A declared active memory mechanism Phi0 is changed to Phi1 inside a bounded write set, with fixed contents, paired frozen hidden M-Bench workloads, delta ablation, migration guard and external promotion/rollback. \textbf{Dataset:} PUB-MOMEGA-D01, PUB-MOMEGA-D02, PUB-MOMEGA-D03, PUB-MOMEGA-D04, PUB-MOMEGA-D05 \textbf{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.memory\_scoring:gate} \textbf{Key:} computed (form, I\_$\Phi$) \textbf{Retention:} every lower M level retained on its own witness & diff $\cdot$ scope $\cdot$ act $\cdot$ beh $\cdot$ $\Delta$\_abl $\cdot$ Mig $\cdot$ K & forms\\
\end{longtable}}
